newsitem.title: FRANCE: IRAN TENDERS FOR 50,000 TONNES OCTOBER BARLEY.
newsitem.headline: IRAN TENDERS FOR 50,000 TONNES OCTOBER BARLEY.

text.p: Iran on Tuesday launched a tender for 50,000 tonnes of barley to be shipped in October, European grain traders said.
The tender calls for offers to be submitted today.
The tender is nominally for barley of optional origin but grain from the United States, Germany, Britain or Norway is excluded, traders said.
Iran has long had difficult relations with the United States and Britain, while Norway severed ties with Tehran two years ago.

Relations between Iran and Germany suffered over a German court ruling in April accusing Iran's leaders of having sanctioned the murders of a group of Iranian Kurdish leaders in a Berlin restaurant in 1992.
